name: Oskar Hargedahl
headline: Data science and AI
summary:
Consulting and personal projects. Most recently Lead Data Scientist at Lassie. Additional previous experience from growth & experimentation focused data science at Spotify and strategy consulting at Boston Consulting Group.

Strong academic background with a masters degree in Management & Digital Technologies from LMU Munich and an honors degree in Technology Management from CDTM - Jointly offered by LMU Munich and the Technical University of Munich (TUM). Bachelors degree from Uppsala University with a major in Business and Economics, and a minor in Computer Science. Additionally, one semester as a Visiting Researcher at the University of California Berkeley, and one semester at Hanken School of Economics in Helsinki. 

Athletic background as a member of the Swedish national team in American Football.
